notes: The operator driver briefing identifies the western rectangular turn, main straight, eastern first turn and southern infield return of the racing course. The apron perimeter, runway, pit lane and driver-training loop are excluded. The two catalogue entries retain the same course with different private start/finish lines. Course pavement centers are independently digitized from the public Min karta orthophoto viewer. The native Swedish-grid image tiles, exact request extents and hashes are pinned before Web Mercator reprojection. Capture year is not asserted. No vertices are fitted to private diagrams, timing positions or nominal distance. Fine alignment and historical direction remain draft. Independently digitized aerial centerline: 2007.6 m. Direction, historical configuration and fine corner alignment remain draft; no course coordinates come from the comparison catalogue.

Estimated constant-width corridor: width is stored in track.json; inner, outer and ideal lines are calculated in the browser from the mapped trace. Local widening and earlier boundary corrections are not retained by this approximation.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 70 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the mapped trace, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.
